_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a global, diversified, and highly differentiated provider of benchmarks, data, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, energy and commodity, and automotive markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, high interest rates, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the energy and commodity markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; the 10-K names generative AI as a risk to demand for its products (GENAI, on the watch list below)

theme_watch.reason: Live: S&P Global's own FY2025 10-K, under 'AI presents new and evolving risks, and our approach to AI may not be successful.', says 'The emerging availability of “off-the-shelf” AI models may also increase the ability of new and existing competitors to develop technology and applications which may compete with our products and services.' and 'Our competitors are deploying AI in ways that could materially reduce demand for our products and services (for example, by deploying AI in ways that make collection and processing of information relatively inexpensive or free or by leveraging AI to build products and services that compete with our products and services).' It builds AI of its own: 'In order to remain competitive, we have made significant investments in various AI initiatives.' The stock trades at 30.9x FY26E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of S&P Global's data, ratings or benchmarks specifically.

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a global, diversified, and highly differentiated provider of benchmarks, data, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, energy and commodity, and automotive markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, high interest rates, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the energy and commodity markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; the 10-K names generative AI as a risk to demand for its products (GENAI, on the watch list below). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.79x; +29% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.03; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.1%/yr (FY26 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.1%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +33.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2026-03-06) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.79x (63.1% downside to Bear $167 / +35.3% upside to Bull $612) | Adj composite 2.52 vs market 2.55: gap -0.03 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +29% above the EPP floor $352 (24x FY26E $14.66) | Conservative 2-yr case: +14.1% total (+7.0%/yr) | At 30.9x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $598 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Financial Services revenue +9.9% in Q4 2025, forward revenues +6.6-8.6% (FY26 revenue guide); generative AI is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
